body:
In this article, we’ll share a collection of elegant fonts that are free to use and that can be applied to a variety of contexts.

What is the most luxurious font?

A luxury font is exactly how it sounds, luxury fonts create a sense of elegance, class and prestige—Now, not every font can be considered a luxury font because the choice of which font you choose for your project is critical to its success.

However, web and graphic designers who use predesigned fonts in their daily work need to understand the nuts and bolts of typography and browse websites for downloading fonts in order to choose the best typefaces for each piece.

Like people, fonts, too, have varied personalities— as such, they can spark emotions, initiate conversations, and dictate how messages are received.

That's why I thought it'd be a good idea to share my top ten favorite luxury fonts for graphic design to help you get started.

10 Best Luxury Fonts

  1. Rollgates Luxury
  2. Magnolia
  3. Adorn Story
  4. Adora Bouton
  5. Branch Font
  6. Allenoire
  7. Le Major
  8. Santorini
  9. Perfectly Splendid
  10. Coldiac

Why choose the Luxury Fonts

Just like it suggests, elegant font is one that feels very formal, classic or luxurious from the moment you see it—Usually, most of these elegant fonts are script and handwritten typefaces or take their inspiration from the world of calligraphy.

The choice of font is crucial to the success of any design project—It’s not just about the images used—No matter how appropriate your visuals are, if your font does not support the overall theme, then the point will be missed.

That’s why we have curated some of the best fonts for projects that demand a high level of class and luxury.

Whether you need sans serif or serif fonts, romance or impact, you’ll find some truly outstanding choices below.

1. Rollgates Luxury

Rollgates Luxury is a gorgeous sans-serif typeface that is both classically elegant and modern.

Elegant font that gives off a natural, organic look.

Create beautiful wedding invitations, use it as an elegant solution for your next magazine layout, power point or choose Rollgates Luxury for any graphics that require a sleek look with a vintage flair.

Rollgates includes a complete set of uppercase and lowercase letters—as well as multi-language support, numbers, punctuation, ligatures.

Whether you are designing a package, a greeting card, or a brand identity, using this enigmatic font will lead you to a successful project.

It imparts a human touch to the writing—all the while keeping it neat and aligned, the broad range of weights make it great for display use, but thanks to its great proportions it also works well for smaller text.

If you're looking for the best handwriting fonts for your marketing project, check out Rollgates font.

‍Download Rollgates Font

2. Magnolia

Magnolia is a modern serif typeface. Clean, delicate, classic—Elegant all caps font with feminine bonus logos.

Ideal for long-form writing and articles.

It includes a set of lower case alphabets, as well as a bonus collection of ornament fonts, which you may use to add distinctive and classy finishing touches to your script.


This makes it much easier to line the two up in a combination project, each font also comes with alternates, so you can get creative with your logos or images.

The Magnolia font is something you can enjoy using time and time again, with everything from elegant quotes to promotional materials and product packaging.

Wonderfully playful and polished at the same time, this is a cursive font with plenty of flourishes around the letters to demonstrate the charm of the person behind it.

‍Download Magnolia Font

3. Adorn Story

You would fell in love with this Adorn Story font if you are looking for beautiful, refined serif paired with voguish script.

Luxurious font with additional swash lines.

This font is rich with 60 ligatures—it also has beginning uppercase, beginning and ending lowercase swashes.

Adorn Story is perfect for branding, photography, invitations, quotes, watermarks, advertisements, product designs, social media posts, stationery and labels.

You can vary between a light and heavy vintage look, depending on how many letters you alter (how many ligatures), it is a very versatile font that can be used for a wide range project types: from food packaging, to weddings invitations, to cosmetic brands and so much more.

It doesn’t matter for whatever purpose you use it; this beautiful font ensures that your text stands out from the rest.

‍Download Adorn Story Font

4. Adora Bouton

Adora Bouton includes full set of gorgeous uppercase and lowercase letters, numerals, a large range of punctuation and ligatures.

Adora Bouton is a cool and flowing typeface that will capture an amazing result.

All lowercase letters include beginning and ending swashes, giving realistic hand-lettered style—All uppercase letters include beginning swashes, that makes the font look fabulous!

In order to use the beautiful swashes, you need a program that supports openType features such as Adobe Illustrator CS, Adobe Photoshop CC,Adobe Indesign and Corel Draw.

Photoshop CC and higher have a glyph panel where you can access the swashes & alternates—Select the font and go to Window Glyphs and double-click on the glyph you want to use.

Flex this on your writing now!

‍Download Adora Bouton Font

5. Branch

Branch Modern Ligature Font with elegant style this is perfect for branding, logos, invitation, masterheads and more.

Perfect for all designers who likes a modernized font.

Graphic and type designer Sans and Sons has created this beautiful font—whether apart or together, these fonts have been designed to add this special ‘hand lettered’ touch to your work.

The Branch font comprises three fonts, which compliment each other very well—with an elegant yet playful touch, they can be used for a variety of needs including apparel design, invitations, logotypes, and many others.

The typeface is equipped with an impressive set of opentype features including stylistic alternates, ligatures, and end swashes.‍

Branch includes also a monoline and bold monoline font if you want some thicker typecase on your writings—if you are looking for the best font check this out.

‍Download Branch Font

6. Allenoire

Allenoire—Modern Bold Serif Font is a stylish font that has both modern and retro look ensures your design stands out.

A font that has a modern and retro look.

You can use this beautiful font family for a variety of applications including print, web, branding, advertising, magazines, products, packaging, labels, just to name a few.

Characterized by its elegance and extreme contrast, the design is influenced by the serif didone genre, but the typetempt studio removed the serifs for a more unique and modern expression.

Apart from the alluring formation of each letter, Allenoire includes alternative characters that you can use to decorate your text and create a one-of-a-kind look.

Overall, it is one of the best and realistic handwriting fonts for those who love the fun and playfulness of cursive, with curves and loops in both the uppercase and lowercase versions of letters.

Why not flex this on you writings now?

‍Download Allenoire Font

7. Le Major

If you are looking for a display font that will bring in your projects a touch of luxury and style, Le Major might be a great option for you.

It will help you to create unique and distinctive designs.

Equipped with numerous weights plus a wide range of swash alternates, ligatures, and other typographic features, the Le Major font family will help you to create unique and distinctive designs.

The font combines elegance with this intended quirkiness and some unique styles—It is well suited for a great variety of designs such as classic themes, retro design, posters, and more.

These are multipurpose and people use it to showcase their products and this handmade font is in upper & lower case and it includes numbers, special characters and few symbols it also has an imperfect flow that will give your text a unique & natural look.

Fall in love with its very adaptable style and use it to make stunning wedding invitations, exquisite stationary art, eye-catching social media posts, and more!

‍Download Le Major Font

8. Santorini

Santorini is a display serif font with luxury, elegant, modern, unique and classy-look—It contains a full set of lower & uppercase letters, and multilingual support.

A typeface with a stunning character.

The font also contains several ligatures and contextual alternates for lower case characters, accessible in the adobe illustrator glyphs panel, or under stylistic alternates in the adobe photoshop menu.

Inspired by the Greek island, Santorini is a script font that can be used for a wide range of graphic design and typographic projects including branding, logotypes, signage, greeting cards, magazine covers, website headers, just to name a few.

This makes it much easier to line the two up in a combination project, each font also comes with alternates, so you can get creative with your logos or images.

Carefree, cheerful, and straightforward, this is one of the best handwriting fonts if you want a typography which isn’t going to hurt the eyes with too many flourishes and cursive elements.

‍Download Santorini Font

9. Perfectly Splendid

Perfectly Splendid is magical, sophisticated typeface with 5 fonts to enchant your next project.

Very versatile fonts that works great in large and small sizes.

Perfectly Splendid is perfect for branding projects, home-ware designs, product packaging, magazine headers – or simply as a stylish text overlay to any background image.

All in all, a pretty and dainty font that will give your designs a beautiful handmade touch, the beautiful ligatures and stylistic alternates of Perfectly Splendid will give your designs an original, yet timeless look.

This typeface was designed primarily for luxurious headlines and titles, but it can also work well for creating distinctive wordmarks, also comes with a variety of style options, visual extras, and a special script font variant.

So, if you want your business to appear lively while still being dignified, Perfectly Splendid is a fantastic font family to use.

‍Download Perfectly Splendid Font

10. Coldiac

Coldiac Serif Font is a modern serif font family whose design refers us to the style of transitional serifs.

A font where you can access all glyphs and swashes with ease.

The distinctive features of Coldiac – Luxury Serif Font are the relatively low contrast of strokes, the slightly squarish shapes of round characters and the emphasized businesslike nature.

Coldiac Serif Font features an original stylistic set which, when turned on, adds features of typical pointed-pen serifs to some of the lowercase characters.

In addition, Coldiac Serif Font has small capitals for Latin and Cyrillic alphabets, as well as several interesting ligatures.

The magnificence of this font is grounded on its ability to combine various features and be used for scientific purposes, be retro, modern, and playful at the same time.

When used properly, this typeface can help deliver a bold, confident brand image whether it’s used in your logo, business cards, website, or newsletters.

Conclusions

The intricate touch of elegance and class offered by handwriting font cannot be found in other fonts.

When your branding or logo project needs a touch of class or elegance, choosing a luxury font can go a long way towards making your project stand out.

With our list of the Best Luxury fonts for branding and logo design, we hope that we’ve provided you with the fonts you can use to provide your absolute best for your clients.

Luxury font helps you add unique and artisan feel to your logos and graphic designs.

There are a number of elegant fonts available in the market, but I tried to present you with my top 10 best luxury fonts.

This guide will save your time and efforts to find the next typeface to add to your collection.
